newsitem.title: UK: COPPER EDGES OFF LOWS DURING LME EVENING TRADE.
newsitem.headline: COPPER EDGES OFF LOWS DURING LME EVENING TRADE.

text.p: Copper prices moved up during Monday evening LME inter-office trading, basically bouncing off downside support, traders said.

The market had earlier fallen to $2,270 - the lower end of the current $60 jobbing range - on stale bull liquidation. The lower end of the range is likely to be challenged again, however, as warehouse stocks continue to rise, they said.
At 1800 gmt three months copper was indicated at $2.282/2,287 a tonne. This was up from a last kerb trade of $2,274.
Aluminium was indicated at $1,750/1,752, little different from final kerb levels.
